intro.text: Placed after SPI or test equipment, it pulls NG boards out of the flow into reject layers while OK boards continue. Single-lane and dual-lane versions.

items: Stainless steel rollers with belt conveying
Adjustable lift height for single-layer screening
Frame of high-strength steel plate and aviation-grade aluminium profile
Safety door lock that stops the machine when a door is opened
Selectable flow direction, left to right or right to left
Standard SMEMA interface for inline connection with other equipment
